claims.statement: Stand-alone profit increased 55% quarter-on-quarter in Q4 FY24.
Consolidated revenue and profit reached highest ever levels in FY24.
Ivory Coast manganese mine exploration found quantities and qualities unfit for commercial exploitation; pursuing alternate mine allocation 3x the size.
Arbitration award payments: $110 million expected over next 6 months ($5 million for 1-2 months then higher amounts).
Growth projects of ~$700 million identified (debt and equity funded); large chunk for Zambia Phase 2, plus Ivory Coast manganese/smelter and agri expansion.
Zambia power plant doubling to 600 MW progressing fast; government treats as critical project due to 12-hour daily power cuts.
Current quarter production committed at 80-90% of overall capacity.
Magnetite mine in Zambia (323 hectares) at early stage; investment quantum to be determined after exploration and reserve estimation.
MEL Phase-II 300 MW power plant capital outlay US$ 400 Mn
MEL long term debt tied-up US$ 200 Mn from NAPSA

NBEIL Q1 revenue INR 201 crore, PBT INR 68.2 crore, PAT INR 44.4 crore; plant operated at 91%+ PLF, full year PLF expected over 70%
No large capex in India; planned capex from overseas: Maamba Phase II, Avocado pack house, Ivory Coast exploration, lithium exploration licenses
